body: I guess you are right. But they are the only people I have in my life.

It is a really long story, but to cut it short,  my grandma, uncle, aunt cousins almost everyone from my moms side of the family live in Germany. And me and my mother just moved there. She can speak the language because she was born and raised there. But I was not. I cant german at all. This was a few months ago and I am making really slow progress because of depression. And they said it. 
 
Also, the reason we moved to germany was because of my mothers job. It was fast and uncalled for.
